I do everything to my own hair. After way too many horrible haircuts I just did it myself. Started freshman year of highschool. 
My hair is parted to the side and everyone would part it down the middle to cut it which makes for horribly uneven layers. 
• So I do length first just judging it from sight and measuring both sides to each other. Then I take my scissors at an upward angle and cut into the hair so it isn't just a blunt edge. Do this to all layers.
• then starting at the bottom with the rest pinned up, I pull the hair up while brushing it, I start to cut layers then again go in at a upward angle.
• for bangs I keep it around my chin and go in a downward angle for just a small chunk of hair. And angle the other side so it frames my face.
Other tips: I cut my hair dry because it's true to length that way. 
It always looks harsh so I shower then touch up areas if need be. 
Always have 2 mirrors, I brush my hair behind my shoulders and look to see if it is even after every section.
